KLIPPO | {{PRODUCT_NAME}}
FORMAT: Vertical 9:16, realistic footage, 10 seconds. Preset: Lifestyle.
MASTER REFERENCE: Use the uploaded product image as the authoritative reference. Preserve its exact visible design, colour, pattern, shape, scale and proportions; do not invent features, included accessories or claims.
SETTING: Apartment entryway.
MODEL: PARTIAL_MODEL. A Malaysian adult woman, framed from shoulder to hip with no face visible, places the reference handbag on her shoulder, walks two natural steps and steadies its actual strap.
CAMERA: Medium shoulder-to-hip tracking, then a stable side view. Natural physics and spatial continuity.
LIGHTING: Soft daylight. Preserve the product's true colour.
STORYBOARD: 0–2s establish the product in its stated setting; 2–6s perform the specified practical action in one continuous take; 6–9s show the real product detail during use; 9–10s hold the product clearly in frame.
AUDIO: Off-camera voiceover in natural Malaysian Malay, with no Indonesian accent: "Beg pilihan saya, senang dibawa untuk keluar hari ini." The visible model remains silent. Subtle background music. No logos, captions or watermark.
